content: Calculation of the waiting for new data period The waiting for new data period is the waiting period for new cycle execution which is cal- culated after each reception of data if RteComDataE2EXfNNDExtensionFactor is configured for data with E2E transformation configured by multiplying the following: • The cycle time configured according to requirement [SWS_Rte_04655]. • The calculated no new data extension factor [SWS_Rte_04662]. 406 of 1609 Document ID 84: AUTOSAR_CP_SWS_RTE Specification of RTE Software AUTOSAR CP R25-11
